aiMetadata.description: Sends a question to a configured Denser.ai chatbot and returns its generated answer, optionally steered by a custom prompt, a chosen LLM model, and inline citations. Use it to query a Denser.ai knowledge-base chatbot for a natural-language response. Requires a question and the chatbot connection; not idempotent, since each call produces a freshly generated answer.
